# Environmental Health 

This section introduces the **principles of Environmental Health**,
focusing on how natural and built environments influence human
well-being.\

## Goals of the Section

-   Understand the scope and importance of **Environmental Health**

-   Learn how environmental factors such as **water, air, light, and
    radiation** impact communities

-   Explore preventive and promotive measures to reduce environmental
    risks.

## Chapter Listing


-   **[One Health](env_health/module1_one_health.qmd)**
    - Definition and pillars of One Health  
    - India’s mission and One Health Index  
    - WASH (Water, Sanitation, Hygiene) integration  
    - Surveillance systems  
    - Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) and its global relevance  


-   **[Environment & Health](env_health/module2_environment_health.qmd)**
    - Components of the environment (air, water, soil, light, radiation)  
    - Sanitation and its role in health  
    - Pollution sources and pathways of exposure 

-   **[Chapter 1: Water and Health](env_health/water.qmd)**\
    Safe water supply, sanitation, waterborne diseases, and control
    measures

-   **[Chapter 2: Air and Health](env_health/air_health.qmd)**\
    Physical and chemical changes in occupied-room air, thermal comfort,
    and ventilation standards

-   **[Chapter 3: Light and Health](env_health/light_health.qmd)**\
    Natural and artificial lighting, the Daylight Factor, and biological
    effects of light

-   **[Chapter 4: Radiation and Noise](env_health/radiation_health.qmd)**\
    Ionizing and non-ionizing radiation, biological effects, radiation
    protection, and noise pollution
